summary.text: Paeonian whom Achilles slew beside Scamander when he drove the allies in flight along the river-banks after Asteropaeus had fallen.

story.text: By the deep-eddying Scamander, swift Achilles went on slaying Paeonians along the banks and brought down Thrasius with Mnesus, Aenius, Ophelestes, and the captains who had stood with Asteropaeus.
